messages:
maya.k: starting an RC origination thread for a lightweight cut (rc-6782). target promo window tonight 02:00 PT. requesting quick signoff and explicit rollback criteria.

devin: ack. can we confirm artifact pin and db migrations are no-ops?

alexw: artifact pinned to sha:abc1234, no DB migration in this cut. small feature flags only.
deploybot: [buildbot] rc-6782 created and pinned - artifact: abc1234. smoke tests: PASS. canary image pushed to staging.

maya.k: thanks. ops, want a short list of rollback triggers we can agree on? latency, error budget, and a content-regression?

sam: propose: (1) 5% sustained error increase for 5m OR (2) p95 latency +200ms vs baseline for 10m OR (3) any data-corruption / incorrect embeddings alerts. If any, immediate rollback.

alexw: adding one: if rerank/eval sandboxes show >3% quality drop on our canary promptset within 10m, roll back.

devin: sounds good. also suggest a deadman-shim: if deploybot detects >20% request failure to model pool, auto-cut traffic and alert sheriff.

ops-bot: deadman-shim enabled for rc-6782 (threshold=20%). KV warm will run at -5m pre-promo.

sheriff: I'm oncall during the window, available via phone. If anything noisy, @maya.k & @devin to be paged.

maya.k: observability gating: please ensure these dashboards are front-and-center: /dashboards/rc-promo/latency, errors, token-cost, model-fallbacks. ops please confirm streaming logs are captured to retention short-term.

ops-bot: dashboards pinned, log retention set to 24h for the promo window. trace sampling increased to 100% for the canary cohort for first 10m.

devin: quick note on rollout plan: 5% canary -> 20% at +10m if clear -> 50% at +25m -> 100% at +40m. Can cut early on manual OK.

maya.k: approved from product side. release notes (short): "rc-6782: small ranking augment; opt-in quantization change for cheaper tokens; no schema changes." Will publish minimal notes before promo.

deploybot: deploy schedule queued:
```
/promote rc-6782 --to prod --pin abc1234 --canary 5 --plan 5,20,50,100 --kv-warm true
```

sam: double-check: canary cohort uses dedicated dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (no mixed tenancy)?

alexw: yes, pinned to dedicated-gpu-pool-2 and fallback route to small-medium-latency model variant if capacity issues.

maya.k: final checklist: docs updated, release notes drafted, rollback criteria agreed, sheriff oncall, kv warm. anyone object to a promo in the window?

devin: no objections.

sam: no objections.

sheriff: no objections.

maya.k: ok promoting as scheduled. will post a final promoter message when deploybot starts.

deploybot: starting promotion: rc-6782 -> prod. initiating canary (5%). rolling out to dedicated-gpu-pool-2.

ops-bot: KV warm started: warming 25% of model shards.

deploybot: canary health check: latency OK, errors within baseline. canary pass at +8m. advancing to 20%.

deploybot: 20% -> health check PASS. advancing to 50%.

deploybot: 50% -> slight p95 spike +60ms for 6m, below the +200ms trigger. continuing to 100% per plan.

deploybot: 100% rollout complete. post-rollout smoke: PASS.

maya.k: thanks team. leaving flag to monitor token-cost for 24h. will schedule a quick postmortem if any anomalies. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: promo summary: rc-6782 promoted by maya.k at 02:11 PT. artifact=abc1234. canary/20/50/100 progression healthy. KV warm OK. deadman-shim not triggered.

sheriff: tagging this thread closed unless a regression surfaces. good job.
